summary: Ran a fresh isolated headless Google Chrome context against local /kariera/ only. HTTP status was 200. Six native details controls were present with only the first initially open; pointer toggling of the second and Enter/Space keyboard toggling of the third produced the expected open/closed states. The CTA updated the hash to its one visible #career-application target. Exactly one file input and one submit control were present. No form was submitted, no file was selected, and no page or console errors occurred.
